reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported database: a Go SQLite driver is declared in go.mod. Deployz hosts PostgreSQL and MySQL only.
reviews.reason: Navidrome uses SQLite as its only database engine and the shown lines give no setting that selects PostgreSQL or MySQL instead.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /data (Dockerfile), VOLUME /music (Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: Navidrome keeps its database and data in /data and reads the music library from /music, and no shown line moves this state to S3 or a managed database.
